title: Organisational Change and Improvement
description: This module supports DFV leaders to drive organisational change, embed trauma-informed practice, and lead continuous improvement. It focuses on change leadership, quality systems, and building structures that support safe, ethical, and sustainable DFV service delivery.
outcomes: Lead organisational change processes that strengthen DFV practice
Embed trauma-informed and ethical frameworks across teams and systems
Use quality improvement systems to drive sustainable organisational growth
